pr_title: networkctl: add verb edit and cat to operate on network configs
pr_body:
This adds two verbs, `edit` and `cat`, to `networkctl` for operating on network configs (namely `.network`, `.netdev` and `.link` files).
Specially, if the config name is prefixed by `@`, it will be treated as network interface name, and operations will be performed on config files associated with the link.

Closes https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/26906

issue_context.body:
### Component

networkctl

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

_No response_

### Describe the solution you'd like


As in https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/26246, it would be worth adding a command to conveniently edit configuration files.

On the networkctl, things are more complicated because we have two types of files: .network and .link.
However, 90% of the time we edit the network file, it could be the main one accessed by the edit command.

The cat command will be very useful diagnostically.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### The systemd version you checked that didn't have the feature you are asking for

_No response_
